[Testing] This helper turns every client integration test into a historical absence assertion solely because encoding events were removed. The focused `LettuceTelemetryTest` already verifies the supported filtering behavior; remove this helper and the `assertCommandEvents` calls, while retaining assertions for real exception events.

Deleting the combined sentence also removes still-applicable guidance for Jedis 1.x, whose module remains deprecated and marked for 3.0 removal. Keep the Jedis-specific statement until that module is actually removed.

[Config] Removing the 5.1 module also removes the public `otel.instrumentation.lettuce-5.1.enabled` selector. A deployment that used this version-specific key to disable instrumentation will now silently get Lettuce spans, but this migration note only mentions the encoding-events property. Document the selector removal and direct users to `otel.instrumentation.lettuce.enabled` in both the changelog and PR migration guidance.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Remove the Lettuce 5.1 javaagent module so the Lettuce 5.0 integration covers all supported 5.0+ clients. Lettuce 4.x and the standalone Lettuce library remain supported.

Remove command-encoding event support from both the Java agent and the standalone library. Library callers must remove `LettuceTelemetryBuilder.setEncodingSpanEventsEnabled`; there is no replacement API:

```java
// Before
builder.setEncodingSpanEventsEnabled(true).build();

// After
builder.build();
```

The Java agent no longer supports `otel.instrumentation.lettuce.experimental.command-encoding-events.enabled`. Neither the agent nor the standalone library emits `redis.encode.start` or `redis.encode.end` span events.

For Lettuce 5.1+, agent telemetry now uses `io.opentelemetry.lettuce-5.0` instead of `io.opentelemetry.lettuce-5.1`. Update any filters or dashboards that match the old instrumentation scope.
metadata.title: Remove Lettuce 5.1 javaagent module
